sqlMap.select: SELECT KEP_PO_NO, KEP_IRS, AGENT_IRS, BUYER_PO_NO, REVISION, SUBJECT, VAT_TOT_AMT, VAT_AMT, AGENT_ITEM_AMT, DS_DATE, JOB_TYPE, JOB_STATUS, START_DATE, CLOSE_DATE, DESCRIPTION, REMARK FROM EAI.KEP_WONBIZ WHERE IF_FLAG= 'N'
sqlMap.update: UPDATE EAI.KEP_WONBIZ SET IF_FLAG = #flag# , IF_DATE = SYSDATE , REMARK = #errMsg# WHERE KEP_PO_NO = #KEP_PO_NO# AND AGENT_IRS = #AGENT_IRS# AND BUYER_PO_NO = #BUYER_PO_NO# AND REVISION = #REVISION# AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
